headline: NYY @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.74 at OAK 2.45, with a projected total of 7.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYY: NYY moved -0.32 runs while OAK moved -1.12, changing the projected margin by +0.80 runs. The projected total fell -1.44, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -11.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Will Warren has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Tyler Soderstrom, Jazz Chisholm Jr., Nick Kurtz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brent Rooker, Jeff McNeil because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
